title: Why several dockless bike-share operators collapsed
text: Dockless bike-share expanded on the assumption that removing docking stations removed the main cost. In practice the dock was doing unpriced work: consolidating vehicles, protecting them from weather and vandalism, and signalling where riders should look. Operators that removed it inherited a rebalancing and repair bill that scaled with fleet size rather than with revenue. The surviving operators reintroduced docks or virtual docking zones.
